title: Amplicon Clean-Up Using SPRI Beads
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7nxhmfn
materials: go to step #7 and repeat ethanol wash.

steps.title: Resuspend SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Vortex Agencourt AMPure XP SPRI beads (Beckman Coulter Catalog #A63880) until the solution is a homogeneous brown colour.

steps.title: Add beads to sample
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (1:1) of the resuspended SPRI beads to the sample tube (e.g., 50 µL beads to a 50 µL reaction) and mix gently by flicking or pipetting.

steps.title: Collect liquid by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Pulse‑centrifuge the tube briefly to bring all liquid to the bottom.

steps.title: Incubate mixture at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 5 minutes (00:05:00) at room temperature.

steps.title: Bind beads on magnetic rack
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes (00:02:00) or until the beads have pelleted and the supernatant is completely clear.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove and discard the clear supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.

steps.title: Ethanol wash and dry
steps.instruction: Wash the bead pellet with 70 % ethanol and dry it.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL room‑temperature 70 % ethanol to the pellet.
Carefully remove and discard the ethanol without touching the pellet.
Pulse‑centrifuge to collect residual liquid and remove as much remaining ethanol as possible using a P10 pipette.
With the tube lid open, incubate for 1 minute (00:01:00) or until the pellet loses its shine (avoid over‑drying which causes cracking).

steps.title: Elute DNA from beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 30 µL Elution Buffer (EB, Qiagen Catalog #19086), mix gently by flicking or pipetting, and incubate for 2 minutes (00:02:00).

steps.title: Transfer eluate to clean tube
steps.instruction: Place the tube back on the magnetic rack, allow beads to separate, and transfer the clear eluate to a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, avoiding any bead carry‑over.

steps.title: Quantify DNA product
steps.instruction: Quantify 1 µL of the eluate using a Quantus Fluorometer with the ONE dsDNA assay (QuantiFluor® ONE dsDNA System, 100 rxn, Promega Catalog #E4871).
